[Refactor] Migrate test_readwrite/test_BIF.py to pytest (#3604)

We are currently experimenting with doing **only** live PR reviews. To
get feedback/review on this PR please join one of our PR review events
on Discord.

**The following checklist is mandatory**

Your PR will be closed if you remove the checklist. Use of LLMs is
**strictly forbidden** for any part of this checklist (including for
improving language), and will result in a **ban** if we find any use of
LLMs.

### Your checklist for this pull request

- [x] Have you followed all the steps from our [Contributing
Guide](https://github.com/pgmpy/pgmpy/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md)?
- [x] Does the PR fully address the linked issue and is within its
defined scope? If you are still working on the PR, mark it as draft.
- [x] Are all the GitHub Actions checks passing? If not, mark your PR as
draft while you fix it.

If you have used AI/LLMs for any assistance, please answer the following
questions. Please refer
[#2622](https://github.com/pgmpy/pgmpy/pull/2622) for an example of the
level of detail we expect:

- [x] Have you reviewed our [AI usage
policy](https://github.com/pgmpy/pgmpy/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-usage-policy)?
- [x] Are you able to fully explain your changes? We expect you to fully
understand the algorithm and take full responsibility for any changes in
this PR.

- Please list the AI tool(s) used, along with the model and its version
used.

Cursor / Grok Bot assistant (model version not independently verified by
me). Used for mechanical refactor assistance only.

- Please describe in **detail** how and what you used AI assistance for?
Please outline your whole workflow with the AI tool.

1. Selected `test_readwrite/test_BIF.py` from the open file list on
#3584 (marked Need to Change).
2. Used AI assistance to draft the unittest→pytest mechanical conversion
(fixtures instead of setUp/tearDown, plain asserts,
skipif/warns/raises), matching the style of already-migrated files such
as `test_UAI.py` and `test_identification/test_base.py`.
3. I reviewed the resulting diff myself: same tests, same constants,
torch backend switch preserved via an autouse fixture, no
algorithm/library behavior changes.
4. Ran the file’s tests locally before opening this PR.

- What steps have you taken to verify that the changes correctly address
the issue? What edge cases have you considered? Other than running
tests, what else have you verified?

- Ran: `pytest pgmpy/tests/test_readwrite/test_BIF.py -q` → **15 passed,
14 skipped** (torch soft-dep not installed in that environment; torch
classes use `pytest.mark.skipif`).
- Diff limited to a single file:
`pgmpy/tests/test_readwrite/test_BIF.py`.
- Compared structure to migrated neighbors (`test_UAI.py`) so
fixtures/asserts match project conventions.
- Confirmed this is a syntax/style migration only — no BIF reader/writer
logic changes.

- Have you used AI for generating tests? Can you compress them into a
smaller number of tests without losing coverage?

No new tests were generated. Existing tests were migrated in place;
coverage set is unchanged.

### Issue number(s) that this pull request fixes
- Part of #3584 (migrates `test_readwrite/test_BIF.py` only)

### List of changes to the codebase in this pull request
- Migrated `pgmpy/tests/test_readwrite/test_BIF.py` from `unittest` to
`pytest` (fixtures, plain asserts, `pytest.mark.skipif` / `pytest.warns`
/ `pytest.raises`).

---------
